changes.incidentTitle: Foxit Workspace: SSRF in file upload and PDF export plus stored XSS in file share preview (CVE-2026-119431, CVE-2026-119433, CVE-2026-119432)
changes.title: Foxit publishes a Foxit Workspace security update fixing SSRF in file-upload (CVE-2026-119431) and PDF-export (CVE-2026-119433) and stored XSS in file share preview (CVE-2026-119432); no customer action required.

changes.incidentTitle: LINE Armeria 1.43.0 fixes path-scoped decorator auth bypass, Thrift memory DoS, and SAML inflate bomb
changes.title: LINE publishes Armeria 1.43.0 and six GitHub security advisories covering path-scoped decorator bypass, Thrift malformed-message memory DoS, armeria-saml HTTP-Redirect decompression bomb, CORS any-origin route ignore, FileService stored XSS, and armeria-xds symlink SDS bypass.

changes.incidentTitle: Alpine Linux sshd password authentication bypass lets anyone log in to key-only accounts (CVE-2026-123158)
changes.title: OpenSSH releases portable 10.6p2 with a fix that avoids a password authentication bypass in sshd affecting some Linux systems built and run without PAM, reported by Özgün Kültekin of Wakefield.

changes.incidentTitle: Alpine Linux sshd password authentication bypass lets anyone log in to key-only accounts (CVE-2026-123158)
changes.title: Alpine Linux publishes its advisory and fixed openssh packages for 3.16 through 3.24 and edge, and says to restart sshd after upgrading or set PasswordAuthentication no.

changes.incidentTitle: Alpine Linux sshd password authentication bypass lets anyone log in to key-only accounts (CVE-2026-123158)
changes.title: MITRE publishes CVE-2026-123158 for the bug: sshd in OpenSSH before 10.6p2 on Linux with musl libc and no PAM accepts any password of 256 to 1024 characters for some accounts (CVSS 3.1 8.1).

changes.incidentTitle: Alpine Linux sshd password authentication bypass lets anyone log in to key-only accounts (CVE-2026-123158)
changes.title: Akamai/Linode publishes a customer security advisory saying its Alpine images are not affected (password-less provisioning leaves PasswordAuthentication off by default; password-provisioned Linodes have no unlocked * password hashes), and points customers at OpenSSH 10.6p2.

changes.incidentTitle: Alpine Linux sshd password authentication bypass lets anyone log in to key-only accounts (CVE-2026-123158)
changes.title: BleepingComputer covers *sshole: Alpine AWS/Azure images ship a default alpine account with passwordless doas, so a successful password login can lead to root; OpenSSH 10.6p2 and apk upgrade openssh are the fixes.

changes.incidentTitle: Alpine Linux sshd password authentication bypass lets anyone log in to key-only accounts (CVE-2026-123158)
changes.title: The Hacker News covers the Alpine/musl OpenSSH password authentication bypass, repeating the four exposure conditions and the apk upgrade + sshd restart fix.

changes.incidentTitle: Keycloak SAML redirect-binding signature bypass lets attackers take over federated accounts (CVE-2026-117691)
changes.title: Red Hat publishes CVE-2026-117691 (CVSS 3.1 9.1, Important): percent-encoded parameter names skip SAML signature verification, allowing unsigned messages to be processed and federated accounts taken over. Red Hat says no mitigation currently meets its criteria; no fixed version is listed yet.

changes.incidentTitle: Keycloak SAML redirect-binding signature bypass lets attackers take over federated accounts (CVE-2026-117691)
changes.title: Keycloak 26.8.2 is released with the fix (the commit "Verify the SAML redirect binding message that is processed" closes CVE-2026-117691), alongside fixes for other SAML flaws including CVE-2026-110931 and CVE-2026-107602.

changes.incidentTitle: TPC Software MatchPoint: static app credential, IDOR, and TLS bypass cluster (INCIBE-2026-841)
changes.title: INCIBE-CERT publishes INCIBE-2026-841 coordinating disclosure of seven MatchPoint (TPC Software) flaws: three critical (CVE-2026-111489 static mobile-app credential → 'autorizado' API token; CVE-2026-111490 IDOR via actingasuser header exposing personal/banking data and account takeover; CVE-2026-111494 Android TLS TrustManager accepts any cert / allows HTTP), plus high SQLi and unauth Images.ashx photo enum and medium plaintext-credential / embedded-config issues. Server fixes for CVE-2026-111490 and CVE-2026-111493 already deployed; remaining issues need the latest app version. Reported by Sergi García Tárraga.

changes.incidentTitle: Apple Multiple Products: WebKit Pointer Authentication bypass (CVE-2024-27834) added to CISA KEV
changes.title: CISA adds CVE-2024-27834 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog; federal agencies have until Nov 18 2026 to remediate.
